reason: The hypothesis proposes a novel synthesis: using rapid solidification to deliberately induce short-range ordering (SRO) clusters in a Co-free FeNiCrMn alloy to enhance the dynamic TRIP effect. No passage studies SRO in this alloy, uses rapid solidification for this purpose, or links SRO to dynamic TRIP. The mechanism connecting SRO to dislocation locking, stacking fault networks, and TRIP is not stated in any passage, and the idea of engineering SRO to modulate dynamic properties is absent from the literature.
